games.name: Animal Crossing: New Horizons - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
games.summary: A carefree new life is just beyond the horizon! Step off the plane and onto your very own deserted island where new friends, discoveries and opportunities are waiting for you. Escape to a deserted island and create your own paradise as you explore, create, and customize in Animal Crossing: New Horizons. Your island getaway has a wealth of natural resources that can be used to craft everything from tools to creature comforts. You can hunt down insects at the crack of dawn, decorate your paradise throughout the day, or enjoy the sunset on the beach while fishing in the ocean. The time of day and season match real life, so each day on your island is a chance to check in and find new surprises all year round. The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of Animal Crossing: New Horizons uses the unique features of the console to offer even more ways to enjoy your island paradise!

games.name: Animal Doctor
games.summary: Make your dreams come true with Animal Doctor! Would you like to spend your life caring for animals? With Animal Doctor you will be surrounded by animal friends and pets.

games.name: Animal Farm Coloring Book for Kids & Toddlers
games.summary: Draw & paint cute farm animals using the touch screen. A relaxing creative coloring book preschool game for kids.

games.name: Animal Farm Jigsaw Games for Toddlers, Babys and Kids
games.summary: The ultimate farm children's game with lots of animal puzzles and farm motifs. The perfect learning game for all children, toddlers, babies, jigsaw puzzle and animal lovers. Familyfriendly!

games.name: Animal Farm Parking
games.summary: Get ready for an exciting adventure at the lively Animal Farm! In Animal Farm Parking, you become the hero of the farm as you guide all the cute and lovable animals out of the crowded pen in the correct order, ensuring they don't collide with each other. Exercise your problem-solving skills and strategic thinking as you navigate through challenging levels filled with twists and turns. Can you create a path that leads each animal safely to its destination? With its charming graphics, immersive gameplay, and delightful animal characters, Animal Farm Parking is a must-play game for anyone who loves puzzles and animals. Can you master the art of animal parking and become the hero of the farm?

games.name: Animal Fight Club
games.summary: Invent new creatures by mixing real or legendary animals in thousands of possible combinations, create an army and fight in the singleplayer campaign or in online multiplayer against friends or random challengers!

games.name: Animal Friends: The Secret Egg
games.summary: Deep in the forest, some little dragon friends discover a mysterious egg hidden among the leaves. Who could be inside?

games.name: Animal Fun for Toddlers and Kids
games.summary: Tap the different animals to interact with them and hear their common sounds or other funny noises. Some animals and little surprises are hidden within the game. Can you find all secrets?

games.name: Animal Golf: Battle Race
games.summary: Cute animal golf battle race game!

games.name: Animal Hospital
games.summary: Young animal lovers are warmly invited to come and discover the fascinating world of Animal Hospital. Put on your vet gear and get ready to save all the animals coming through the doors of your hospital. Soon you will learn everything there is to know about species from all four corners of the world!

games.name: Animal Hunter Z
games.summary: Shoot down the infected animals and restore peace to the island!

games.name: Animal Hunting 3D
games.summary: Are you ready to answer the call of the wild and become the ultimate hunter?

games.name: Animal Kart Racer
games.summary: Fun, fast-paced racing for up to 4 players. Use power-ups and be the first over the finish line in Animal Kart Racer! Are you ready to accelerate, fire rockets and knock your opponents off the road? Animal Kart Racer is a fast and cheerful racing game that puts your driving skills to the test! Choose your driver from one of 16 comical characters such as a raccoon, beaver, wolf or even a shark or crocodile! Race over 20 exciting tracks full of sharp turns, dangerous obstacles and unexpected surprises. Ram through destructible objects, jump from ramps and try to avoid fallen trees, rocks, ice and oil slicks! Hit the road, put the pedal to the metal, and enjoy the intense kart racing in different modes. Play individual tracks or compete in tournaments. Play with friends in the local multiplayer mode for 4 players!

games.name: Animal Kart Racer 2
games.summary: Three, two, one - Step on it! Anything goes in these races: Risky overtaking manoeuvres, shameless crashes and insane pile-ups. Hurtle through deep gorges, glittering diamond caves, icy polar regions and yawning canyons.

games.name: Animal Kingdom 3
games.summary: Animal Kingdom 3 is a hidden animal game where you collect pawprints and cameras while searching animals in fantastic locations! With 3 game modes and jigsaw and swap puzzles between the chapters, Animal Kingdom 3 will provide hours of fun for Hidden Object fans in soothing natural settings!

games.name: Animal Kung Fu
games.summary: Lin, a young and clumsy red panda with big dreams of being a guardian, embarks on a dangerous mission to save his valley.

games.name: Animal Learning Puzzle for Toddlers and Kids
games.summary: In this easy to use animal puzzle game, toddlers and kids can learn the pronunciation and spelling of over 80 animals from around the world. All voice recordings are done by 100% native speakers. The game can be customized to offer different difficulty settings, so children of a great age range can enjoy the puzzles. The spoken languages include: * american english * british english * french * german * italian * european spanish * latin american spanish * european portuguese * brazilian portuguese * dutch * russian Japanese and Chinese languages are coming soon!

games.name: Animal Lover
games.summary: Evil forces have turned these five hunky beefcake time-displaced boys into animals! You've got to help cure them and maybe even fall in love! Mystery! Intrigue! Romance! No furries, despite the title! A dating sim by Wilson Taylor, Maia Gross and Travis Tohill.
